maria-partnerships: Kickoff — Datadog + BrightPath: on‑prem / air‑gapped observability quickstart. Goal: ship a reproducible collector + dashboard package and an onboarding runbook for Redwood Private customers. Lab week proposed May 16-20. Owners: Alex (dashboards/runbook), Raj (collector + deploy scripts), Kim (Datadog partner support), Sam (quickstart repo). Can folks confirm?

alex-observability: Confirmed — I'll own the runbook and dashboard templates. Need a minimal OTLP collector config that works without external egress (file sink or sidecar pull). Also want a small sample dataset and a couple of dashboard widgets for GPU inference traces.

raj-eng-sre: I'll own collector + deployment. Plan: provide two options: (1) file-exporter + local fetch (air-gapped) and (2) optional proxy that forwards to Datadog when connected. Quick snippet below for option (1). Anyone want to review?

raj-eng-sre: ```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: 
      http: 
exporters:
  file:
    path: "/var/log/otel/records.json"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [file]
```

sam-devex: I'll wire up a quickstart repo and a docker-compose lab that spins up the otel collector and a tiny trace generator. Plan to add `make demo` that produces a 1-minute load and exports to the file.

sam-devex: Example command for local run: `docker compose -f docker-compose.lab.yml up --build && make demo` — demo will generate traces and a sample dashboard JSON you can import into Datadog UI.

kim-datadog-partner: Kim (Datadog) here — we can provide dashboard widget examples and a small script to ingest the file exporter into a Datadog intake when the customer chooses to attach. We'll also provide guidance on API key rotation and limited-scope integration keys (recommended for air-gapped attach). Link to partner guide: https://dd.co/onprem-guide (private).

maria-partnerships: Security reqs: KMS/HSM support for storing keys, audit logging for collector reads, and an opt-in network egress control in the runbook. Raj — can you add HSM integration notes?

raj-eng-sre: Yes. We'll include a section: "Key storage patterns" with examples for AWS KMS, Vault, and a note for HSM-backed KMIP appliances. Also adding a small systemd unit example and selinux notes for on-prem hardened deployments.

alex-observability: QA ask: can we prepare 3 verification tests for the runbook: (A) ingest sanity check (trace shows up in dashboard), (B) offline-to-online attach (file forwarder -> Datadog), (C) load spike test (10k spans/min). I'll draft the tests.

kim-datadog-partner: We'll help with (A) and (B) — can provide a small helper to tail the file exporter and POST into Datadog under test credentials.

brightpath-bot: Action created: BP-OBS-2026 - Lab environment and test plan assigned to raj-eng-sre, alex-observability, sam-devex, kim-datadog-partner. Due: 2026-05-14.

maria-partnerships: Deliverables checklist (please reply with :thumbsup: if you accept):
- Runbook (owner: alex-observability)
- Collector configs (owner: raj-eng-sre)
- Docker-compose lab + demo script (owner: sam-devex)
- Datadog dashboard templates + ingestion helper (owner: kim-datadog-partner)
- Security + KMS/HSM guidance (owner: raj-eng-sre)
- Recorded demo + step-by-step onboarding (owner: sam-devex)

alex-observability: :thumbsup: I'll have a first draft of the runbook by EOW.

raj-eng-sre: :thumbsup: I'll push collector examples to `repos/partner/brightpath/otel-onprem` and share PR.

sam-devex: :thumbsup: I'll scaffold the quickstart and CI job to run the lab on PRs.

kim-datadog-partner: :thumbsup: Datadog will provide dashboard JSON and test ingestion scripts.

maria-partnerships: Thanks — next sync Wed 10am PT. Please drop blockers here. Also cc @eng-security if anything funky comes up.

alex-observability: One blocker: we need a concise privacy blurb for customers about what traces include (no PII). Can product/security help draft?

raj-eng-sre: Noted. I'll add a sanitization example in the collector pipeline (span attributes redaction). Example processor snippet: ```processors:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: user.email
        action: delete
```

maria-partnerships: Great — closing notes: final artifact should be importable into a customer's Private console as a packaged "Observability Quickstart" with clear opt-in steps. We'll aim to announce to existing Private customers alongside BrightPath's SI onboarding.

kim-datadog-partner: Sounds good. Kim logging off — feel free to ping me for any Datadog API token edge cases.

maria-partnerships: Thanks team. If no blockers, I'll mark this thread as the canonical place for coordination for the lab week. :rocket:
